title: EntryEvent
description: External channel delivery to the kernel. FR-001 / FR-002 / FR-031.

eventId.description: ULID or UUIDv4. Part of idempotency key (userId, eventId).

userId.description: Channel-provided identifier (OS username, openId, etc.). Idempotency key.

text.description: Natural language command. FR-031: UTF-8 byte length <= 16 KB. Oversize rejected via `event_rejected_too_large` before any Task creation.

sourceChannel.description: Origin channel; ResultSummary MUST be delivered back via the same channel (FR-029).

receivedAt.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision.

meta.description: Channel-specific passthrough. Redacted per FR-020 before audit write.
